task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Using QuTiP, simulate T1 relaxation and T2 dephasing of a qubit (T1=13.2, T2=23.11): evolve |+> under both channels with mesolve and extract effective decay constants by fitting <sigma_x>(t) and excited-state population. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
